summary: Master the fundamentals of financial accounting with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical knowledge to advance your career in finance.
lede: Financial accounting records business transactions and turns them into statements that show financial position and performance. This course is for professionals who prepare, reconcile, or review financial data, including junior accountants, financial analysts, accounts payable or receivable leads, and audit associates. Learners practise double-entry and ledger workflows, asset valuation and depreciation, and the preparation of financial statements and cash-flow reports.
audienceIntro: This training is essential for professionals responsible for the integrity, accuracy, and reporting of financial data within a corporate or institutional context.
modules: Foundations of the Financial Accounting Framework
The Accounting Cycle and Ledger Management
Revenue Recognition and Cash Flow Analysis
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of business operations and numeracy. Prior experience with spreadsheet software (e.g., Microsoft Excel) is highly recommended. No prior formal accounting qualification is required, though familiarity with basic business terminology will be beneficial.
